parent_negative.meaning: v1 cycled display order with row_index, making order perfectly predictive of base class within polarity and allowing a model to bypass SITUATION semantics.

changes: Every fixed semantic/S3-mapping cell is crossed with all six codebook display orders.
Every fixed semantic/display-order cell is crossed with all six S3 mappings.
Situation text and lexical-variant identity remain fixed across display-order and S3-remap counterfactuals.
Validator requires complete six-order cells and complete six-mapping cells.
Validator requires order invariance of target and semantic surface.
Validator computes empirical mutual information for display order versus base class, target class and polarity and fails if nonzero beyond 1e-12 bits.
Class words outside the codebook and any episode atom outside the codebook are fail-closed leakage errors.
Rejected ABI atom 'or', missing observed token IDs and non-single-token production atoms are rejected before generation.
repair.factorization: 6 S3 mappings x 4 semantic template families x 2 query polarities x 3 base classes x 6 display orders

exact_source_local_validation.verification_method: Git blob SHA-1 computed from exact local bytes matched GitHub fetch_file blob SHA for both source and test.
